title: Work order card at rest matches the design
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • You are signed in as a user with the "Admin" role at {Location-A}.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • The browser window is 1440 px wide with the zoom at 100%, and the design pictures "card-02-n1-rest.png" (board 1.2) and "card-05-n1-picked.png" (board 1.5) attached to this case are open beside it at 100% (actual size). Names, numbers and dates in the pictures are sample data.
  • Two active staff members at {Location-A} have their "Sales Representative" switch on: {Sales-rep-A} and {Sales-rep-B}.
    For example: {Sales-rep-A} is ZZAUTOTEST Ann Able and {Sales-rep-B} is ZZAUTOTEST Ben Able.
  • Customer {Customer-A} has no sales representative.
    For example: {Customer-A} is ZZAUTOTEST SSR Fleet.
  • Work order {Work-order-1} for {Customer-A} is open and not invoiced with nobody in Sales Representative; work order {Work-order-2} has Sales Representative {Sales-rep-A}.
    For example: {Work-order-1} is S2-40001 and {Work-order-2} is S2-40002.
  • Starting screen: {Work-order-1} is open in that browser window.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Without hovering, compare the Lead Technician, Service Advisor and Sales Representative rows with the picture of board 1.2.
  2. Measure the gaps between Lead Technician, Service Advisor and Sales Representative.
  3. Open {Work-order-2} and compare the card with the picture of board 1.5.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: "Sales Representative" sits directly under Service Advisor, label on the first line and "Unassigned" on the second, in the same text style, size, weight and left edge as Lead Technician and Service Advisor; no box, no arrow and no button at rest, as in the picture.
  • Step 2: every gap is 16 px, including the gap under Lead Technician (the design's "before" board measures 36 px there today).
  • Step 3: the name {Sales-rep-A} on the second line as plain text, no box, as in the picture.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Splitting Sales Representatives", Confluence 919928833, version 8 (14 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 19 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10890, story SV-11265 (Story 1, Give a work order its sales representative)

  • S1-R1: “The work order card shows a Sales Representative field directly under Service Advisor.”
  • S1-R2: “The field is the same field as Lead Technician and Service Advisor: the label "Sales Representative" sits inside it on the first line and the name on the second, in the same text style, size, weight and left edge.”
  • S1-R3: “At rest the field shows no box, no dropdown arrow and no buttons beside it.”
  • S1-R6: “The vertical gap between Lead Technician, Service Advisor and every Sales Representative field on the card is 16px. This holds with one field, with the Labor and Parts fields (S2-R5), and on the read-only card (S2-R17).”
  • S1-R7: “With nobody assigned, the field reads "Unassigned".”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.
